name: RDE-inspired value consistency versus matched segmentation-only adapter
status: Prospective exploratory protocol; do not start efficacy before full runner safety gate and audited native reference pass
research_claim: Can training a shared token-value residual toward same-source GT-mask memory values improve frozen SAM2 segmentation over native and an identical segmentation-only residual? This is not full RDE-VOS reproduction or a novelty claim.

prior_audit.interpretation: Positive TRAIN oracle headroom, not learned efficacy. Prior SupCon/MemSAM interventions did not establish a robust deployment gain.

data.initialization: Same first-labelled-frame GT mask prompt and chronological sampling as current native manifest; evaluate every postprompt frame.
data.independence: PolypGen cohort, validation and historical test have informed earlier work. Treat all PolypGen outcomes as exploratory development; do not claim untouched confirmation or verified patient independence.

conditions.C0: Native frozen SAM2; reuse compatible existing baseline after per-mask rescore and provenance verification
conditions.C1: Shared 64→128→64 author SAM2 MLP zero residual on nonconditioning spatial V before all four v_proj layers; segmentation/object-presence loss only
conditions.C2: Identical MLP/initialization/data/optimizer/budget plus official RDE channel KL to detached same-source GT-mask V retaining native source object score, coefficient10/temperature1

training.sequence_order: Numerical order as train_sequences, repeated unchanged each epoch; reset to first GT prompt at every sequence and epoch
training.segmentation_loss: Reuse reader_clip_loss: pre-presence-gating selected mask supervision plus author SAM2 object-presence loss, with identical weights in both arms.
training.consistency_loss: Unchanged pinned RDE KLDivLoss mean over channel distributions; mean of four layer losses, temperature1, coefficient10. No additional normalization or lambda search.
training.own_memory: Each arm propagates its own predictions and native BF16 writes. No postprompt GT mask/teacher value enters prediction or its bank. GT teachers are generated after each student forward, kept separately, and aligned by past frame/object ID/native value/native score hashes.
training.teacher_compute_control: Generate and validate the same teacher targets in C1 as in C2; coefficient exactly0 for C1. No teacher at inference.
training.first_read: A conditioning-only read has no repairable values and no optimizer step. It still creates a detached target for the next source; this is a structural graph case, not confidence selection.
training.evaluation_checkpoint: Fixed final epoch3 only; no best-epoch selection, early stopping on outcomes, seed selection or hyperparameter tuning. Intermediate training logs are optimization diagnostics only.
training.device: CPU FP32, native persistent memory BF16, one intra-op thread, deterministic algorithms
training.augmentation: None; no random crops, shuffled frames, GT prompt refreshes, confidence gates or token deletion.
training.checkpoint: Atomic adapter/optimizer/Torch+Python+NumPy RNG, sequence+epoch+frame cursor, predicted bank, detached target cache, input/source hashes and immutable per-frame receipt. Exclusive writer lock. Resume must match full runner engineering gate.

validation_screen.when: After fixed3 epochs for primary seed, full seq13-15 rollouts for both arms; do not change config afterward.
pass_all: C2 wins at least2/3 validation sequences against C0 and at least2/3 against C1
C2 equal-sequence GT-empty false-alarm rate - C0 <=0.02 absolute
validation_screen.if_fail: Stop this frozen candidate; no replication seed search or historical test rollout. Analyse TRAIN/validation failures without tuning on test.
validation_screen.if_pass: Run both additional seeds with the same fixed schedule, report all seeds without choosing best; compare mean-seed validation effects with the same Dice/false-alarm conditions before historical test/transfer release. Replication failures must be reported.

metrics: return events and frames to overlap, missed events retained
inference time/FPS, peak memory and actual key/value token counts
evaluation.historical_test_release: Only after primary and mean-seed validation screens pass. Evaluate the fixed final checkpoints of all three seeds on seq16-23; label exploratory historical test, not independent confirmation. Do not use these outcomes to choose modules, losses, seeds or checkpoints.
evaluation.secondary: Conditional full DAVIS2017 validation using official persistent indexed IDs and equal-object J/F/J&F. Existing compatible native baseline may be reused after provenance and saved-mask audit. DAVIS has been used for engineering/development here, so do not claim untouched external confirmation. A genuinely independent public dataset remains required for a strong publication claim. SA-V is unavailable.
evaluation.native_reference_runtime: Existing native validation used2 CPU threads; current engineering/training uses1. Saved-mask metrics may be audited, but no runtime equivalence is assumed. Before candidate efficacy, reproduce native validation once with the frozen one-thread runtime and compare every saved mask with the prior reference; retain the matched one-thread C0 even if old masks differ.
evaluation.seed_aggregation: Average scores across the three predetermined seeds within each sequence, then give sequences equal weight. Report every seed separately; do not count seed×sequence rows as independent observations.

engineering_before_efficacy: Completed bound native/identity parity, full 28672 capacity, all4 layers, prompt/pointer and positions, shared MLP gradients
Natural multi-object ID insertion-order and isolated-object equality with nonzero fixture
Own-rollout teacher association and no-GT-bank leakage; conditioning-only startup
Fresh-process own-rollout full bank/teacher/optimizer/RNG exact replay
Full runner cursor, checkpoint, exclusive lock, source/input hash and evaluation-cache corruption tests; real-frame interruption/resume gate
stopping: Any integrity failure stops immediately; no fallback to loose tolerances, skipped cases or outcomes-based amendments. Preserve attempts. A screen pass motivates evaluation only, not a guaranteed Dice gain or publishability.
limitations: A token-only MLP has no extra object-pointer input. Identical native values for two lost objects cannot be mapped to distinct object-specific GT values by this module; multi-object identity isolation does not prove recovery from that ambiguity. Do not claim universal denoising or change the architecture after seeing test outcomes.

The unchanged RDE mean-reduced channel KL has scale/shift ambiguities and its weight was not calibrated for SAM2. The fixed segmentation-only comparison determines whether this auxiliary target adds value.
Historical PolypGen test and previously used DAVIS do not establish independent confirmation.
